name: Argyll and Bute
eyebrow: West Scotland · Islands and sea lochs
title: Argyll and Bute —
title_em: sea lochs, islands and the birthplace of Scotland.
tagline: Oban, Mull, Iona, Islay and the cradle of the Scots kingdom.
summary: Argyll and Bute is Scotland's second-longest coastline of sea lochs, peninsulas and islands: Mull, Iona, Islay, Jura, Bute, Colonsay and many more. The kingdom of Dál Riata, from which Scotland grew, was based here.
Iona was the home of St Columba's monastery from 563, and Islay is famous for its smoky malt whiskies.
